title: True or false: World regions
intro: Decide whether each statement about the world is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Netherlands (Kingdom of the) is classified in Western Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Netherlands (Kingdom of the) in Western Europe.

statements.text: Liechtenstein is classified in Eastern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Liechtenstein in Western Europe, not Eastern Europe.
